S4A says more and more ex-Berners are likely to realize what we socialists already came to know: that an independent left party which doesn't take 1% money is the only way to go to organize a working class movement toward socialism in the USA!

Link to NY Times article: https://www.nytimes.com/2020/11/07/us/politics/aoc-biden-progressives.html
